title: Edge Case Detection in Automated Driving: Methods, Challenges, and Future Directions
abstract: arXiv:2410.08491v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Automated vehicles (AVs) promise to enhance transportation safety and efficiency. However, ensuring their reliability in real-world conditions remains challenging, particularly due to rare and unexpected situations known as edge cases. While numerous approaches exist for detecting edge cases, a comprehensive survey reviewing these techniques is lacking. This paper bridges this gap by presenting a hierarchical review and systematic classification of edge case detection and assessment methodologies. Our classification is structured on two levels: first, by AV modules, including perception and trajectory-related (encompassing prediction, planning, and control) subsystems; and second, by underlying methodologies and theories guiding these techniques. translated_title: 自动驾驶中的边缘情况检测：方法、挑战与未来方向
translated_abstract: 自动驾驶车辆有望提升交通安全性及效率。然而，确保其在现实世界条件下的可靠性仍具挑战性，尤其是由于罕见且意外的情况，即所谓的边缘情况。尽管存在多种检测边缘情况的方法，但缺乏对这些技术进行综述的全面研究。本文通过呈现边缘情况检测与评估方法的分层回顾和系统分类，弥补了这一空白。我们的分类基于两个层级：首先，按自动驾驶模块分类，包括感知和轨迹相关（涵盖预测、规划及控制）子系统；其次，按支撑这些技术的底层方法论和理论进行分类。此外，我们引入了“知识驱动”方法，该方法通过利用专家见解和领域知识来补充数据驱动方法，以识别训练数据中缺失的情况。
tldr: 本文首次系统性地对自动驾驶边缘情况检测方法进行分层分类综述，并创新性地提出知识驱动方法以补充数据驱动技术的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first hierarchical and systematic classification of edge case detection methods in automated driving, and innovatively proposes knowledge-driven approaches to complement data-driven techniques for identifying missing cases.
